content_finding: No accessible transcript or usable public captions in bounded reads. IMF page direct request returned HTTPError (unknown status); public YouTube caption-track request returned HTTP 200 but empty body. The video itself was not downloaded or transcribed. Therefore no claim about whether Warsh made a December/consecutive-hike policy statement is supportable from this follow-up; preserve as unresolved source gap.
method: All three attempted GET sources were captured through scripts/read_capture.py before parsing. The YouTube video page is on the IMF channel. Raw/gzip hashes cover supplied response bytes, not wire authenticity. No retries or bypasses.
